name: SD: A sawmill whose blades go dull (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A sawmill's log yard, green planks, dry lumber and blade sharpness, counted every hour. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-sawmill/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests effects: how fast logs are sawn depends on how sharp the blades are (full speed when sharp, much slower when dull), sawing wears the blades down, and a sharpening station restores them at a limited pace.
